verdict.rationale: Granola documents a real in-meeting disclosure feature: it posts a message in the meeting chat when it starts transcribing so everyone knows. That is a product capability, not just a policy. However, the evidence is a single introductory line, with no detail on which meeting platforms support it or whether it is on by default. Missing for 10: admin-enforced transparency (workspace-level policy forcing disclosure on), participant notifications outside the meeting chat, platform coverage and configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Granola posts a message in your meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know.
